## Checklist
- [ ] `make check` and `make test` pass
- [ ] A new check or sweep rule has a test using recorded output
- [ ] Anything that changes a machine shows the change first, goes through the journal, and has a way back
- [ ] No personal values (names, emails, hostnames, IPs, real command output)
- [ ] No em dashes
- [ ] The title starts with `feat:`, `fix:`, `security:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `test:`, `ci:` or `chore:`
